//: Who is about by season. Prologue design values (26.09.2026), temperate north-east as the model. Code: src/game/loot/Seasonal.js, read by LootRoller.encounterChance / rollEnemy through opts.season, opts.phase and opts.night (LootRoller.worldOpts). Each creature's own rate is multiplied: a table's chance and its mix change together, so a creature that sleeps through the winter is simply not met, and nothing else is met more often because of it. Machines (ELECTRONIC) are never touched: nothing about them is alive. A season's `all` multipliers apply first, then its phase's (early = days 1-30, mid = 31-60, late = 61-91); groups may overlap and multiply.

boldness.//: How much harder a predator is to rout, by season: its rout line in a fight (Combat's ROUT_THRESHOLD) is multiplied by this, so 2 means it has to be hurt twice as badly before it breaks off, and a hungry predator does not bolt at the sight of you (Encounter). Read through Flee.boldness.
